13143152437b040f.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Senior IT Analyst to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves supporting the Data Analytics function by extracting, analyzing, validating, and interpreting data to develop dashboards, reports, KPIs, visualizations, and actionable insights. The Senior IT Analyst will play a crucial role in supporting clinical, operational, and corporate decision-making across the group. Key Responsibilities Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights. Extract, clean, validate, and prepare data from approved sources for analysis and reporting. Develop, maintain, and update dashboards, reports, and data visualizations. Support KPI definition, calculation, validation, and performance reporting. Ensure data quality, accuracy, consistency, and reliability in reports, dashboards, and analytics outputs. Perform data validation, reconciliation, and issue follow-up with relevant stakeholders. Collaborate with clinical, operational, and corporate stakeholders to understand data requirements and reporting needs. Support data governance activities, including data definitions, standardization, and documentation of approved reporting logic. Conduct advanced analytics, statistical analysis, and modeling where applicable. Communicate analytical findings, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner. Document data sources, business rules, calculations, assumptions, and report specifications. Support testing and validation of new dashboards, reports, analytics products, and data integrations. Participate in data governance audits, compliance activities, and data quality improvement initiatives. Handle complex analyses with greater independence and engage directly with stakeholders to define requirements, validate outputs, and provide recommendations. Mentor junior analysts and support the delivery of assigned analytics initiatives. Continuous Improvement and Compliance Perform all duties in alignment with Fakeeh’s Person-Centered care values. Maintain strict confidentiality of all sensitive information. Comply with cybersecurity policies and standards, participating in awareness training to prevent cyber threats. Uphold Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies, and ethical standards. Complete mandatory education requirements at least one month prior to expiration. This position involves assessing cross-domain impacts and defining end-to-end implementation strategies for network changes. The successful candidate will contribute to building robust solutions and ensuring the integrity of network transformations. Key Responsibilities Analyze service requirements, High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), and Service Design Packages. Assess cross-domain impact across CS Core, IMS, and PS Core. Define the end-to-end implementation architecture and deployment strategy. Lead technical risk, impact, rollback, and dependency assessments. Define testing, validation, KPI monitoring, and acceptance criteria. Review and approve Method of Procedures (MOPs), scripts, implementation plans, and change packages. Act as a technical authority during Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews and major implementations. Support root cause analysis and post-implementation reviews. Drive architectural standards, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in telecom Core Networks, with a minimum of 8 years. Strong expertise in PS Core and good expertise in CS Core & IMS. Hands-on experience with MME, EPG, PCC/PCG, SAPC, SMF/UPF, NEF, ESOA, and iDNS. Experience with HLD/LLD analysis, impact analysis, migrations, upgrades, and network transformations. Experience working with change management, CAB governance, and operational handovers. Skills and Attributes Strong stakeholder management skills. Proven technical leadership abilities. About Ericsson At Ericsson, you will have the opportunity to utilize your skills and imagination to develop solutions for complex global challenges. You will join a team of diverse innovators focused on shaping future technologies.

Experience sourcing candidates through multiple channels and building talent pipelines. Knowledge of recruitment processes, interviewing techniques, and candidate assessment methodologies. Ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills. Familiarity with localization initiatives such as Saudization, Emiratization, or other regional workforce programs. Experience recruiting across multiple countries within MEA. The selected candidate will be responsible for translating architectural and interior design concepts into precise technical documentation and coordinating production processes. Key Responsibilities Review architectural and interior design drawings, specifications, BOQs, and project requirements. Prepare detailed Shop Drawings, Sections, Details, and installation drawings for joinery and woodwork items. Generate accurate Quantity Take-offs, BOQs, BOMs, Cut Lists, and material schedules. Analyze costs related to material, labor, machinery, finishing, transportation, and installation. Coordinate technical requirements with production, CNC, procurement, finishing, and installation teams. Issue RFIs and identify discrepancies in drawings, dimensions, specifications, and site conditions. Review site measurements and update drawings prior to production. This full-time role requires 3-5 years of experience and involves ensuring high service excellence and operational efficiency during assigned shifts, acting as the primary operational decision-maker in the absence of the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager. Key Responsibilities Act as the Lounge In-Charge during assigned shifts, making operational decisions when the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager is absent. Supervise all lounge functions, including reception, F&B, and housekeeping, to ensure smooth operations. Oversee guest check-in and admission procedures in compliance with company policies and lounge access guidelines. Greet, receive, and bid farewell to guests professionally. Handle guest enquiries, feedback, and complaints, ensuring prompt resolution. Support and guide Guest Service Officers in daily operations and customer interactions. Monitor lounge areas to ensure cleanliness, comfort, and readiness. Coordinate with housekeeping, maintenance, and kitchen teams to resolve operational or service issues. The role requires active supervision and coordination within a dynamic lounge environment, ensuring a seamless experience for guests. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. The salary for this position is not disclosed.

13b96b93f6df176c.description: About Dar Wa Emaar Dar Wa Emaar is a Saudi real estate investment and development company headquartered in Al Khobar. The company focuses on creating communities and destinations that enhance living, working, and connecting. With a team of investment professionals, planners, engineers, and project managers, Dar Wa Emaar delivers high-quality developments across the Kingdom, contributing to the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. About the Storekeeper Role Dar Wa Emaar is seeking a Storekeeper to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves performing a variety of shipping, receiving, and stocking activities, as well as maintaining inventory and stock records. The Storekeeper will be responsible for storing and distributing supplies and equipment, and may also serve as a lead worker to other classified staff in the area. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Maintain district inventory for Plant supplies, including ordering, receiving, and allocating. Prepare and type annual requisitions, orders, reports, and correspondence. Receive and inspect all incoming materials, reconciling them with purchase orders. Process and distribute documentation related to purchase orders; report, document, and track damages and discrepancies on orders received. Post daily incoming and outgoing plant stock. Report canceled and damaged items to the purchasing department as appropriate. Handle and document the storage and transportation of hazardous materials. Ensure identification, segregation, and preservation of stored materials. Maintain the warehouse, records area, and stores area in a neat and orderly manner. Segregate waste for proper disposal. Inform relevant personnel about material arrivals and arrange for inspection. Answer questions regarding procedures and resolve discrepancies concerning receipts, deliveries, warranties, repairs, and surplus property. Arrange for the return of non-conforming materials. Issue materials as per requirements and maintain accurate records. Perform other duties as assigned. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a storekeeping or similar inventory management role. Work Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. While the company is headquartered in Al Khobar, this specific role will operate out of Riyadh.

This role is responsible for driving revenue growth specifically in cold-storage jackets and workwear, PPE, safety products, and corporate uniforms. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in a relevant sales role. Key Responsibilities Identify and qualify new leads within sectors such as cold storage, logistics, food and beverage, manufacturing, retail, and construction. Conduct client visits to understand safety and workwear requirements, recommending suitable products like thermal jackets for freezer environments or PPE for site and warehouse use. 133e04a27ad364de.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها. يتطلب الدور تقييمًا مستمرًا لتطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية العلاج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه لجمع المعلومات اللازمة. دراسة الحالة المرضية بدقة وإجراء الفحص السريري اللازم لتحديد التشخيص. طلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير النتائج والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفاعلية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية بشكل دوري. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها وفقًا للإجراءات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة علمية في الطب مع تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل يعمل الطبيب الاخصائي ضمن فريق صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان في مدينة تبوك. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى في بيئة مهنية وداعمة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق طبي متخصص والمساهمة في تقديم خدمات الرعاية الصحية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

FHM was established via a strategic agreement between the Technical & Vocational Training Corporation (TVTC), the Saudi Commission for Tourism and National Heritage (SCTH), and Saudi Aramco, aiming to support national workforce development and professional excellence. The center collaborates with leading organizations to align its training with current market needs and international best practices. This role involves designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs in facility management. The trainer will ensure that all course content adheres to FHM standards and industry best practices. Key Responsibilities Prepare comprehensive training materials for various programs. Conduct both classroom and practical training sessions effectively. Assess learner performance and provide constructive feedback to support their development. Collaborate with other trainers and administrators to update and improve curricula. Support continuous improvement initiatives within the training center. Participate in training-related events and workshops to stay current with industry trends. 132fbe658455ddea.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ثمار، الرائدة في قطاع التجزئة والجملة، عن محاسب تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة وتحليل التكاليف، والمساهمة في تحسين العمليات المالية وزيادة الربحية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات، ويفضل أن تكون في مجال الأغذية والمشروبات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتحليل تقارير التكاليف الشهرية لضمان دقة البيانات وتقديم رؤى للإدارة. تطوير نماذج التكاليف لتحسين دقة تقديراتها وتحليل الفجوات بين التكاليف الفعلية والمخططة. التعاون مع الفرق التشغيلية لتحديد مجالات تحسين التكاليف وتقليل الهدر. إجراء مراجعات دورية للعمليات المالية لضمان الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. تقديم دعم مالي للمشاريع الجديدة من خلال تقييم التكاليف والمخاطر المرتبطة. تدريب وتوجيه الموظفين الجدد في قسم المحاسبة لتعزيز مهاراتهم في إدارة التكاليف. تطوير استراتيجيات فعالة لإدارة التكاليف تتماشى مع أهداف الشركة طويلة الأجل. مراقبة التغييرات في القوانين واللوائح المالية لضمان الامتثال الكامل. تقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة العليا حول أداء التكاليف وتوصيات للتحسين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال محاسبة التكاليف. خبرة سابقة لا تقل عن ثلاث سنوات في مجال الأغذية والمشروبات. شغف بالتفاصيل وامتلاك مهارات تحليلية قوية. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على إدارة وتحليل التكاليف بفعالية. مهارات قوية في اتخاذ القرارات المالية الاستراتيجية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي ومتعاون. بيئة العمل ستعمل ضمن بيئة عمل تشجع على التعلم والتطور، وتوفر برامج تدريبية وورش عمل لتعزيز المهارات في المحاسبة وإدارة التكاليف. تتاح الفرصة للعمل مع محترفين في المجال، مما يعزز فرص التقدم الوظيفي وتوسيع المعرفة المحاسبية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. معلومات إضافية الراتب المتوقع لهذا الدور يتراوح بين 5,625 ريال سعودي و 7,500 ريال سعودي.

13f10b5b561c6aec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التكامل الخليجي للصناعات الغذائية عن كاتب علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على توفير المعلومات اللازمة لتخليص المعاملات الحكومية ومتابعة إجراءات التخليص، بالإضافة إلى استكمال المتطلبات الإجرائية ومتابعة معاملات الموظفين بالتنسيق مع الجهات الخارجية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بالوثائق والمستندات والشروط المطلوبة لتخليص المعاملات الحكومية. تأمين وتوفير المستندات اللازمة وتخليص المعاملات بفعالية وسرعة، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. تحديث واستكمال جميع متطلبات النماذج والمستندات والإجراءات الحكومية بما يتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح المنظمة. تنفيذ التعليمات المتعلقة بسرية التعاملات والسجلات، والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ الوثائق وتبويبها وترتيبها وفقاً للممارسات المتبعة في الشركة. استقبال استفسارات الموظفين والإجابة عليها، ومتابعة معاملاتهم بالتنسيق مع موظفي الوحدات الخارجية المعنية، وإحاطتهم بكافة المستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع وتحليل المعلومات المتعلقة بالمتطلبات الحكومية. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لحفظ وتصنيف الوثائق. المهارات المطلوبة الالتزام بالسرية والمهنية في التعامل مع المعلومات الحساسة. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتنسيق مع الجهات الداخلية والخارجية. القدرة على متابعة الإجراءات واستكمال المتطلبات بدقة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق شركة التكامل الخليجي للصناعات الغذائية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

13c5d1b104675d81.description: The Legal Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and following up on the company's legal matters, managing legal documentation, monitoring cases and claims, and ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations in Saudi Arabia. The role is performed on a part-time basis according to the agreed working schedule. Key Duties and Responsibilities 1. Legal Cases and Claims Follow up on legal cases, disputes, and claims involving the company. Coordinate with external lawyers, legal consultants, and relevant authorities. Prepare and organize documents and supporting evidence required for legal proceedings. Monitor court hearing dates, legal deadlines, and case updates. Maintain updated records of ongoing legal matters. 2. Contracts and Agreements Assist in preparing and reviewing contracts and legal agreements. Coordinate contract reviews and approvals with the relevant departments. Monitor contract expiration dates, renewals, and terminations. Maintain organized and confidential records of legal documents. 3. Legal Compliance Monitor relevant changes in Saudi laws and regulations. Assist in ensuring company compliance with applicable legal requirements. Follow up on legal notices, violations, and official correspondence. Identify potential legal risks and report them to management. 4. Government and Legal Authorities Coordinate legal transactions with government and judicial authorities. Follow up on cases and requests through relevant government platforms, including Najiz. Prepare official letters and legal correspondence. Monitor the implementation of legal decisions and required procedures. 5. Employment and Labor Matters Coordinate with the HR Department regarding labor disputes and employee-related legal matters. Prepare and organize documents related to employment contracts, warnings, investigations, and terminations. Follow up on labor complaints and claims. Support the preparation of legal documentation related to disciplinary procedures. 6. Reporting and Documentation Prepare periodic reports on legal cases, claims, contracts, and pending matters. Maintain accurate and updated legal records. Ensure confidentiality of all company legal information. Complete assigned legal tasks within the required deadlines. Perform other related duties assigned by management. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, or a related field. Must have completed legal training or be currently undergoing training at a licensed law firm. Good knowledge of Saudi labor and commercial laws. Familiarity with Saudi government and legal platforms. Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Ability to handle confidential information professionally. Work Schedule This is a part-time position , with working hours determined by mutual agreement based on the company's operational requirements. The employee must ensure timely follow-up on assigned legal matters and meet all applicable deadlines. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely follow-up on legal cases and deadlines. Accuracy and completeness of legal documentation. Regular updates on pending legal matters. Effective coordination with lawyers and relevant departments. Completion of assigned tasks within agreed timelines. Note: The Legal Coordinator performs administrative and legal coordination duties. Providing independent legal opinions or representing the company before courts is subject to applicable professional licensing requirements and company authorization.

Previous experience in delivering workplace training. An understanding of ESS or similar electronic-based reporting systems. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience to effectively manage the responsibilities of this role. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply, demonstrating their qualifications and experience for this critical role within BAE Systems.

132566ecd1b41e1a.description: We're looking for someone to run our paid media and grow our online sales. If you've managed over 1M SAR in a quarter and can walk us through what that money actually brought in, we'd like to talk to you. Day to day, you'll run and optimize campaigns on Facebook and Instagram (Meta), TikTok, Snapchat, X, Google Ads and GDN. You'll decide where the budget goes and move it when the numbers tell you to. The focus is on e-commerce sales. That's the part of the business we need the most help with, so we want someone whose experience is in conversion campaigns, not brand awareness. You'll plan by the quarter, then break that down month by month, week by week, and keep an eye on things daily. Big seasons like Ramadan, Eid, National Day, Founding Day and White Friday are a large part of our year, so planning ahead for them matters. We also have physical stores in Jeddah, and we want to understand how digital affects them. That means running Store Visits campaigns and finding a way to measure the impact on branch sales. On the technical side, you should be comfortable setting up and managing tracking yourself: GTM, GA4, and the pixels for every platform we run on. Experience with Meta CAPI, server-side tracking, attribution and incrementality testing is important to us, since we want to trust our numbers. Our store runs on Magento. You'll report weekly, monthly, and quarterly on ROAS, CPA, the funnel and paid vs. organic performance and tell us what you'd change based on what you see. Ideally, you've worked in the Saudi or GCC market, preferably in fashion or retail, and you're comfortable in both Arabic and English. Experience with CRM, email or WhatsApp marketing, influencer campaigns (Mawthooq), or Noon and Amazon ads would be a plus. To apply, send your CV along with one campaign you're proud of, including the budget, the results, and anything you'd do differently now. Feel free to hide brand names.
